description: Checks the live HTTP response headers of a site's home page (one GET, https) for Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy. Returns present/missing headers with their values and a score out of 7. It does not judge the quality of the values. Choose this tool for: Checks the live HTTP response headers of a site's home page. Close alternatives on this server: security_cors_misconfig (Checks how a site's home page answers a cross-origin); security_cookie_security (Lists the cookies a site sets on its public home page). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_security_headers
title: Checks the live HTTP response headers of a site's home page
